title: Toki
build: Ocean type 1 cartridge, 16 banks of 8 KB (128 KB)

records.c: Copy six consecutive directory entries, X stepping by 8 from the value in A.

Copy one entry of the cartridge directory into RAM. Selects bank 0 ($80 to the Ocean bank register $DE00), reads the entry at $8009+X (source bank, source address, destination, length), then switches to the source bank and copies.
NMI handler. CIA 2 timer A fires it once a frame ($4CC7 cycles, set at $8006); it keeps $01 at $35 and does the work flagged in $08B0.
First code the game runs from RAM (the hand-over, entry.vsf): clears $C480-$C53F, copies 192 bytes to $44E1 and selects bank 13.

Point the NMI vector at nmi_frame ($4D1D), switch the cartridge into view ($01 = $37), enable the CIA 2 interrupt, copy six cartridge directory entries into RAM with cart_copy_six, then hide the cartridge again ($01 = $35).
Keyboard matrix scan through CIA 1 ($DC00 rows, $DC01 columns), called from $80FC.
Sound start-up: clears the filter resonance ($D417) and sets volume 15 with the low-pass filter ($D418 = $1F). The SID writes in the census all fall in $6615-$6ED4.
Start of a game: initialise, set the CIA 2 timer for the per-frame NMI, wait for raster line $EE, blank the screen and enter the stage.
Main loop wait: spins until the interrupt changes $08F7, once a frame; every PC sample in play lands here.
Raster interrupt for the play area, written into $FFFE each frame on line 248; sets sprites, scroll and colours for the top of the screen.
Raster interrupt for the status panel, written into $FFFE on line 216.
